_comment: Item definitions. Ported from the InventoryItem STI subclasses (WoodInventoryItem, IronInventoryItem, LootBoxInventoryItem, IrradiationEnclosureInventoryItem). category: material | lootbox | placeable. Items with a lootTable can be opened with the Use action. Items with stackSize 1 get a unique instance id.
